adaptation to facial expressions of trustworthiness improves discrimination around the adapted level of trustworthininess, and the improvement occurs even when adapting to different faces with different gender and identities.
adaptation to facial expressions improves sensitivity to facial expressions.

the question of how the human face is perceived, and the role of our experience in this process.
the role that adaptation plays in the perception of faces.

adaptation to facial characteristics can improve discrimination of facial features that convey the same level of that facial characteristic.

adaptation to facial features improves sensitivity around the adapted feature.
